## TRA Timeline

#### IPO and TRA execution

- 2023-10-10: Tax Receivable Agreement executed between Birkenstock Holding plc and BK LC Lux MidCo S.à r.l. (L Catterton-affiliated Pre-IPO Shareholder).
- 2023-10-11: NYSE IPO closes.
- 2023-10-12: 424B4 prospectus describes the TRA terms and the approximately $550M expected aggregate payment over roughly 13 years.
- 2024-01-18: FY2023 Form 20-F files the executed TRA as Exhibit 4.7.

#### First cash payment

- 2026-03-31: Q2 fiscal 2026 6-K reports the first cash payment under the TRA: EUR 14.6 million during the six months then ended.

## Explanation

The TRA originates from Birkenstock's October 11, 2023 NYSE IPO and obligates Birkenstock Holding plc to pay 85% of certain U.S. and German realized tax savings to BK LC Lux MidCo S.à r.l. (the L Catterton-affiliated Pre-IPO Shareholder), in respect of tax attributes created by MidCo's 2021 acquisition of the BIRKENSTOCK Group. Aggregate expected payments are approximately $550M over roughly 13 years. The contract was contemplated alongside a contemporaneous share buy-back from MidCo and carries standard Early Termination Payment mechanics on change of control or elective acceleration. No amendments or terminations have been filed; the May 2024 credit agreement contains a Permitted Payments carve-out for TRA payments but does not modify the TRA. The first cash payment of EUR 14.6M was made in the six months ended March 31, 2026. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
